notes: Solved independently: for a satellite in a bound circular orbit U = -GMm/r is negative (A-II), E = U + K = -GMm/2r is negative (B-II), K = +GMm/2r is positive (C-I), and the potential energy at infinite separation is the zero reference (D-III). That is option 3. Every printed equation is correct and each follows the text above it; the statement that the total energy is equal in size to half the potential energy is right, since |E| = GMm/2r and |U| = GMm/r. common_mistakes[1] reproduces option 4 exactly (B to Positive, C to Infinity), and common_mistakes[0] names a real trap in match-the-following items, that a label may be used twice.
